workflow: Generate 2D modeling references and seamless material albedos; reconstruct geometry using Blender MCP Python; export GLB; integrate into the Three.js game.

references.architecture: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: 2D modeling reference sheet for a semi-realistic military first-person game's modular European rural buildings. Primary request: a coherent production concept sheet showing a weathered two-storey farmhouse, a single-storey brick workshop and a taller industrial brick warehouse. Three separate three-quarter orthographic exterior drawings and a small row of detailed facade/roof elements below: deeply recessed wooden sash window with stone lintel and sill, paneled double doorway, exposed foundation stone, plaster over worn brick corners, tiled gable roof with overhanging wooden eaves and dark gutter, a chimney and chipped wall corner. Buildings have believable construction thickness, clear proportions, strong distinct silhouettes and restrained wartime wear, with occasional broken panes and repairs. Style: finely rendered 2D architectural concept art made for Blender modeling, tactile diffuse materials and soft neutral light, light gray studio background, clearly separated assets. Muted off-white plaster, weathered ochre brick, stone gray, faded timber and charcoal roof tiles, natural palette. Wide landscape high-resolution sheet. No characters, no vehicles, no labels, words, logos, watermark or UI. Avoid generic boxes, neon colors, perfectly repeated unweathered surfaces and exaggerated destruction.
references.vehicles: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: 2D vehicle concept reference sheet for Blender recreation in a semi-realistic first-person combined-arms game. Primary request: six clearly separate detailed three-quarter orthographic military vehicle drawings on a neutral light gray studio background. A matte olive armored 4x4 recon truck with angular enclosed cabin, sloped windshield, four thick off-road wheels with realistic hubs, spare tire, roof pintle HMG and shield; a modern main battle tank with layered wedge turret, long cannon, sloped armor, continuous tracks and visible road wheels; an eight-wheeled armored personnel carrier with sloped bow and small autocannon turret; a compact attack helicopter with faceted glass tandem canopy, twin engine housings, tail boom, skids, main rotor and chin gun; a rugged four-wheel ATV; and a small rigid-hull military patrol boat with pointed bow and outboard motors. Each has believable mechanical construction, seams, hinges, vents, bolts, stowage and natural dirt. Style: polished 2D production concept art with readable form and restrained realistic materials, moderate detail suitable for real-time Blender models, not photoreal photographs. All six fully in frame with generous gaps, arranged in two rows. Muted olive, charcoal rubber, steel and subdued glass; no national insignia, brand marks, labels, text, logos, UI or watermark. Avoid block toys, glossy plastic and disproportionate wheels.
references.props: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: 2D battlefield prop reference sheet for Blender model recreation. Primary request: clearly separated orthographic three-quarter production concept drawings of these six prop families: a low stack of irregular stuffed olive-khaki burlap sandbags with soft sagging pillow silhouettes, visible sewn seams and tied ends; two weathered wooden military supply crates with actual individual planks, recessed lids, metal corners and faded markings without legible words; three battered steel fuel drums with subtle dents, ribs, bungs and chipped dark olive paint; a faded blue steel shipping container with corrugated sides, locking-bar doors, reinforced corner castings and worn edges; a rough concrete barrier with bevelled chipped edges; and a small stack of stone rubble and broken boards. Realistic scale cues from construction details, strong readable shapes, believable restrained rough surfaces. Finely painted semi-realistic 2D game modeling reference, neutral gray background, soft neutral studio light, isolated full objects and plenty of spacing, wide landscape composition, no characters, no scenery, no text, labels, logos, UI or watermark. Sandbags must look filled with granular material and lumpy soft fabric, never like bricks. Avoid cartoon colors, identical geometry and plastic shine.

materials.burlap: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: seamless square diffuse albedo texture for individual modeled battlefield sandbags. A flat orthographic macro material scan of weathered muted olive-khaki coarse woven burlap, visible fine crossing natural fibers, slight uneven dusty wear and faint stains. Uniform fabric filling the image edge to edge, restrained natural variation and no directional lighting. Tileable all four edges. No depiction of bags, seams, blocks, bricks, objects, folds, shadows, text, symbols, logos or borders. This texture is only fabric, not a picture of a bag stack.
materials.plaster: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: seamless square diffuse albedo texture for weathered rural house plaster in a first-person game. Flat orthographic material scan of warm pale ivory lime plaster, subtle rough aggregate, fine hairline fissures, tiny worn pores, softly mottled mineral and gray-brown weathering. Entire canvas a continuous surface, low contrast, diffuse even neutral light, no baked shadows, perspective, building silhouette, large cracks, bricks, words or border. Seamless on all four edges.
materials.roof: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: seamless square diffuse base-color texture for a European farmhouse roof modeled in Blender and rendered in a first-person game. Flat orthographic material scan of courses of irregular aged dark slate tiles in warm charcoal and gray-brown, subtly chipped lower edges, small subdued lichen patches, natural varied slate grain. Eight tiles across, ten horizontal courses, precisely seamless edges and continuous staggered bond. Even diffuse neutral light, no perspective, shadows, highlights, roof silhouette, chimney, objects, text, logos, watermark or borders. Muted restrained palette, never vivid orange, single material filling the square.
